title: Jamaican Chicken Teriyaki
description: A unique fusion of Jamaican and Japanese flavors, featuring chicken cooked in a sweet and spicy teriyaki sauce.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together curry powder and jamaican jerk seasoning.
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken breasts, making sure to coat evenly.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.

While the chicken is cooking, combine soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, and water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing into thin strips.
Serve the chicken with the teriyaki sauce spooned over the top. Garnish with chopped spring onions and serve over rice or noodles.
Optional: serve with steamed vegetables or a side of pickled ginger for added flavor and nutrition.
Cook time includes time for chicken to rest after cooking.
Note: if using a grill, cook the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
